prompt: The same forest clearing, same framing, same trees, finish gate, moon and mountains as the reference, same painterly hanji-paper grain, simple large masses, no lace, no patterns. Five round paper lanterns hang on thin cords from the top edge, glowing warm amber. The sky is a rich, clear picture-book dusk wash, a smooth vertical gradient: warm glowing peach-orange at the horizon, through soft coral and rose-red, into a deep dusky blue at the top. Rich and luminous like gouache, colourful but gentle, suitable for bedtime, not neon and not fiery. The far ridges are flat mid-tone shapes in dusky rose-brown, a little darker as they come nearer, with soft mist between them. Foreground trees, gate and ground are very dark near-black with a slightly visible warm dark-brown ground around the centre so puppets standing there still stand out. No glowing outlines on trees. NO purple, NO violet, NO lavender, NO magenta. ABSOLUTELY NO characters, animals or people: the foreground stays open for puppets.
